nicheStories.title: When retailers wait to reveal prices, shoppers fill in the blanks

A growing number of retailers were asking shoppers to take one more step—add to cart to see price, click to reveal, sign in to view price—before revealing an item's cost. The paper is published in the Journal of Consumer Research.
